title: youngia japonica subsp. elstonii
intro: Youngia japonica subsp. elstonii, commonly known as Elston's Youngia, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family, closely related to the dandelion and chicory. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion, thereby providing relief from digestive issues such as constipation and diarrhea. The therapeutic actions of Elston's Youngia include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and serve as an anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its various health benefits and therapeutic actions.
